title: Push-pull for coherent systems under a proper map that is an isomorphism off V(K): for Y Noetherian, J, K quasi-coherent ideal sheaves, f : X -> Y proper and an isomorphism over V = Y \ V(K), I = f^{-1}J O_X, (G_n) in Coh(Y, J), F coherent on X and beta : (f^*G_n) -> F^ an isomorphism in Coh(X, I), there exists alpha : (G_n) -> (f_*F)^ in Coh(Y, J) whose kernel and cokernel are annihilated by a power of K.

core_obligations: Define gamma_n and prove existence/uniqueness of alpha after reducing to Y affine via the formal-functions identification lim M_n = M^ and the affine equivalence of categories.
Transfer the problem to the completed base Y' = Spec(B^) using flatness of completion, flat base change for f_*F, and the equivalence of modules killed by J^n and (J')^n.
In the J-complete case descend beta through fully-faithfulness to b : f^*G -> F and identify alpha with the completion of the adjunction map.
Bound kernel and cokernel by a power of K from the isomorphism over V via power-ideal-kills-sheaf.

difficulty_reason: The construction and all verifications are in the span: gamma_n is defined as the composition G_n -> f_*f^*G_n -> f_*(F/I^nF) (adjunction plus f_*beta_n); uniqueness of alpha with prescribed compositions lets one reduce to Y = Spec(B) affine, where M_n = H^0(X, F/I^nF), M = H^0(X, F), and Lemma ML-cohomology-powers-ideal plus Theorem formal-functions identify lim M_n with the completion M^; via the equivalence of categories of lemma-inverse-systems-affine, alpha must correspond to lim gamma_n : N = lim N_n -> M^ as finite B^-modules. The kernel/cokernel bound is transferred by base change to Y' = Spec(B^): B -> B^ is flat (algebra completion-flat), f'_*F' and f'_*(f')^*G_n' are pullbacks by flat-base-change-cohomology, and modules annihilated by J^n versus (J')^n are equivalent (More on Algebra neighbourhood-equivalence), reducing to B complete in J. In the complete case (G_n) = G^ for a coherent G, beta descends through fully-faithful to an isomorphism b : f^*G -> F, and alpha is the completion of G -> f_*f^*G = f_*F; the adjunction map restricts to an isomorphism over V, so its kernel and cokernel are supported on V(K) and are killed by a power of K by power-ideal-kills-sheaf.
